## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes, adds, or fixes, and the motivation behind it.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature or analyzer plugin
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance optimization or refactor
- [ ] CI / Tooling improvement

## Related Issues
Fixes #(issue)

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows existing project style (`npm run lint` passes with 0 errors).
- [ ] TypeScript types compile without errors (`npm run typecheck` passes).
- [ ] Vitest unit & integration tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] Crawler service builds successfully (`npm run prebuild`).
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`npm run build`).
- [ ] Documentation updated where appropriate (README.md, AGENTS.md, etc.).
